Population increased in Ashford

The estimated population of Ashford in 2024 was 140,936 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

This meant that Ashford's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Ashford increased by 5.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, Ashford was also among the 20% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Ashford

The average (median) age rose to 41.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Ashford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Ashford is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Ashford's population of 140,936 usual residents was made up of:

  • 27,567 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.6%)
  • 85,568 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.7%)
  • 27,801 people aged 65 years and over, (19.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Ashford has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (60.7% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Ashford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Ashford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Ashford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 172 people (0.1%). In total, there were 1,416 births and 1,244 deaths in Ashford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 438 (0.3%). There were 7,439 people entering the area and 7,001 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Ashford's population of 1,326 (1%) as a result of 2,110 people entering the area and 784 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Ashford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Ashford in mid-2023 is 139,010.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 690 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 37 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 727 people.
